title: 游标逐行处理 vs 集合操作：SQL 语句数与结果的确定性对比
expected_output:
=== 游标逐行处理 vs 集合操作(处理 10000 行) ===
做法               SQL语句数         取行数(FETCH)     结果校验和       
A 游标逐行           10000          10000          70000       
B 集合更新           1              0              70000       

两条边界行校验: A(id=1)=7, A(id=10000)=7 | B(id=1)=7, B(id=10000)=7
结果完全一致        : True
语句数比值 A : B    : 10000 : 1
结论: 二者语义等价, 但游标版的 SQL 语句数随行数线性增长(O(N)),
      集合版恒为 1 条(O(1) 语句 + O(N) 元组处理), 因此能用集合就别用游标。
code:
import sqlite3

# 用 sqlite 真实建表, 对比两种"等价"做法的操作计数(确定性判据, 不用墙钟耗时)
#   做法 A: 模拟游标逐行处理 —— 逐行 FETCH 后逐行 UPDATE
#   做法 B: 集合操作 —— 单条 UPDATE 处理全部行
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=None)   # autocommit, 手动 BEGIN/COMMIT
con.execute("CREATE TABLE member(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, points INTEGER)")
N = 10000
con.executemany("INSERT INTO member VALUES(?,?)", [(i, 0) for i in range(1, N + 1)])

# ---- 做法 A: 游标逐行 ----
con.execute("BEGIN")
fetched = 0
sql_stmts_a = 0
for rid, pts in con.execute("SELECT id, points FROM member").fetchall():
    fetched += 1
    con.execute("UPDATE member SET points = points + 7 WHERE id = ?", (rid,))
    sql_stmts_a += 1
con.execute("COMMIT")
sum_a = con.execute("SELECT SUM(points) FROM member").fetchone()[0]
a1 = con.execute("SELECT points FROM member WHERE id = 1").fetchone()[0]
aN = con.execute("SELECT points FROM member WHERE id = %d" % N).fetchone()[0]

# ---- 做法 B: 集合操作 ----
con.execute("UPDATE member SET points = 0")
con.execute("BEGIN")
con.execute("UPDATE member SET points = points + 7")      # 一条语句搞定全部 N 行
sql_stmts_b = 1
con.execute("COMMIT")
sum_b = con.execute("SELECT SUM(points) FROM member").fetchone()[0]
b1 = con.execute("SELECT points FROM member WHERE id = 1").fetchone()[0]
bN = con.execute("SELECT points FROM member WHERE id = %d" % N).fetchone()[0]

print("=== 游标逐行处理 vs 集合操作(处理 %d 行) ===" % N)
print("%-16s %-14s %-14s %-12s" % ("做法", "SQL语句数", "取行数(FETCH)", "结果校验和"))
print("%-16s %-14d %-14d %-12d" % ("A 游标逐行", sql_stmts_a, fetched, sum_a))
print("%-16s %-14d %-14d %-12d" % ("B 集合更新", sql_stmts_b, 0, sum_b))
print()
print("两条边界行校验: A(id=1)=%d, A(id=%d)=%d | B(id=1)=%d, B(id=%d)=%d"
      % (a1, N, aN, b1, N, bN))
print("结果完全一致        : %s" % (sum_a == sum_b and a1 == b1 and aN == bN))
print("语句数比值 A : B    : %d : 1" % (sql_stmts_a // sql_stmts_b))
print("结论: 二者语义等价, 但游标版的 SQL 语句数随行数线性增长(O(N)),")
print("      集合版恒为 1 条(O(1) 语句 + O(N) 元组处理), 因此能用集合就别用游标。")
